name: Help reports
description: What Help > Report a Problem… and Beta Notes show: ProblemReport (the app, its version and build, macOS, the Mac model and the newest three suite crashes at most 7 days old, each a CrashFile trimmed to its header and crashed thread, with the home path, user and host redacted; text puts the person's note on top) BetaNotes.current, the build's known issues, and ProblemReportOutput, what Save… and Email… hand on (the subject "AfterGlow <app> <version> problem", the beta recipients, the .txt name and the sheet's text unchanged; RP-3e). Built from values the caller reads; nothing here reads a disk or opens a socket (report-problem RP-1 stubs, RP-4 bodies).
